subcategory_text: Mechanisms (e.g., failsafe, load balancing, hot swap) are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CP-7 (Alternate Processing Site), CP-8 (Telecommunications Services), SC-36 (Distributed Processing and Storage)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.6 (Capacity management), A.5.29 (Information security during disruption)
implementation_examples: Implement resilience mechanisms (failsafe, load balancing, hot swap, redundant capacity) to achieve defined resilience requirements in normal and adverse conditions
Define resilience targets per service tier
Test the mechanisms periodically against adverse scenarios
assessment_objectives: Determine whether resilience mechanisms are implemented
Determine whether resilience targets are documented per service tier
Determine whether mechanisms are tested against adverse scenarios
Determine whether capacity is sufficient under projected worst case
